patent.title: (Z)-2-cyano-3-hydroxy-but-2-enoic acid-(4'-trifluoromethylphenyl)-amide tablet formulations with improved stability
patent.family_note: Holdout INT-3. Orange Book DP for Aubagio. Do not conflate with use patents US6794410 / US9186346 on same NDA.

knowledge_origin.description: Sanofi assignee; inventor Hauck; pharmaceutical internal formulation RD.

technology.problem: Solid teriflunomide tablets form degradants (e.g. 2-cyano-N-(4-trifluoromethyl-phenyl)-acetamide) on storage.
technology.mechanism: Tablet composition with specified disintegrant/binder/lubricant/diluent bands, excluding colloidal silicon dioxide and/or adding acidic reacting compound to improve stability.
technology.comparison_baseline: Prior teriflunomide solid formulations with colloidal silica and higher degradant formation (patent background).

value_carriers.name: Aubagio® (teriflunomide) tablets 7 mg / 14 mg
value_carriers.description: FDA Orange Book Drug product listing of US8802735 on NDA202992. PI inactive ingredients match claim 1/36/37 composition classes; strengths match. wt% bands not fully public → strong_evidence not fully confirmed.

gaps.description: No public E4 attributing revenue specifically to this formulation patent vs sibling use patents.
Full quantitative wt% for every claim-1 band not on label (claims 36/37 give exact recipes).

notes: Holdout INT-3. T0=2026-10-13. OB DP + claims PASS (strong) → R3; NO auto R4/R5. Formal V0.7; not V0.8.
